modinfo.title: Sample pappt mod (test fixture)
modinfo.author: DMM Phase 3 test
modinfo.description: Smoke-test mod for Phase 3 file-format apply path. Edits primary[0].flag in partprefabtable.pappt — a benign value with no observable in-game effect, suitable for verifying the dmmv3_pappt overlay group is created and registered cleanly. Mount log should contain '[V3_FILE] partprefabtable.pappt → group dmmv3_pappt' on success.
modinfo.note: Hand-written for DMM 1.3.5 pre-release.7. Once NattKh's mod-workbench gains v3-intent export for file-format tables, this fixture's shape is what authored mods will look like.
